title: iOS/iPadOS Intune Enrollment "Access Denied / Not Authorized" — Root-Cause & Remediation (License, MDM Scope, Enrollment Restrictions & Conditional Access) Troubleshooting Guide
author_notes: Pricing: T3 diagnose-and-resolve (DX), new model, matches TMEXTDX/PKEYDX family ($749). Commercial $749, NPO 449.40, Gov 636.65.

Customer symptom (iPhone screenshot): 'Device Management / Access Denied — You are not authorized to view this page. Your IT department may be able to help' with Diagnostic information for IT: Activity Id af992f0f-1790-4677-8ef8-b61de01dfc67, Session Id 90022529-c5ec-41bb-953c-e2c2b8bbb7c7, Timestamp 2026-09-01T14:33:28Z.

VERIFIED: the screen is the Intune enrollment AUTHORIZATION gate (tenant-side), not a device fault. Five gates in likelihood order: (1) no Intune service plan on the user; (2) user outside MDM user scope (Entra > Mobility (MDM and WIP) > Microsoft Intune, appliesTo none/selected); (3) enrollment restriction — iOS/iPadOS platform blocked, personally-owned blocked, or device-limit reached; (4) Conditional Access targeting Microsoft Intune Enrollment app d4ebce55-015a-49b5-a083-c84d1797ae8c or Microsoft Intune app 0000000a-0000-0000-c000-000000000000 (classic require-compliant-device chicken-and-egg); (5) guest/B2B or disabled account.
Deterministic diagnosis: Session Id + Activity Id from the screen -> Entra sign-in logs -> failure reason + Conditional Access tab names the gate. Then confirm with the matching gate script.

5 Graph scripts (read-only, parse-verified): ENRLDX-Get-EnrollmentSignin (failed enrollment sign-in by correlationId/time + CA result), ENRLDX-Get-UserIntuneLicense (INTUNE_A service plan), ENRLDX-Get-MdmUserScope (beta /policies/mobileDeviceManagementPolicies appliesTo + included groups + membership), ENRLDX-Get-EnrollmentRestrictions (platform + personal + device limit), ENRLDX-Get-EnrollmentCA (CA policies targeting the enrollment apps).
gov_variant false: gates + method identical GCC/GCC High/DoD; portals entra.microsoft.us / intune.microsoft.us and -Environment USGov noted inline.
